en_US: A guy named Bill made the Pokémon
PC storage system.
You can access the Pokémon storage
system using the PC at the reception
there. Why don’t you try it once?

It was about three years ago.
This group of thugs called Team Rocket 
was involved in wrongdoing. They were 
abusing Pokémon.
But!
Bad things never last!
A boy did a wonderful job and
Team Rocket was disbanded!
Pokémon are really smart.
Traded Pokémon might not listen to you
right away. For example, high-level
Pokémon sometimes refuse to obey
when you don’t have enough Gym Badges.
